author: The Infographics Show
description:
Sweden spent 70 years avoiding conflict at all costs, but the world just changed. As global nuclear powers shift and the U.S. commitment to NATO wavers, the old rules of neutrality are dead. Today’s epic new video explores Sweden’s desperate need for its own protection, and why that means going nuclear. Sweden has the blueprints, the expertise, and a terrifying new reason to use them.
